## The problem and success criteria

Define the function, supply limits, load, safety boundary, and measurable success
criteria.

## Schematic and prediction

Add the approved schematic. Label components, values, polarity, nodes, expected
current paths, and measurement locations.

## Calculations

Show equations, assumptions, units, significant figures, component ratings, and
one independent check.

## Evidence

| Quantity | Predicted | Simulated | Measured | Unit |

## Build and safe test sequence

Explain power-off checks, staged power-up, meter mode and connection, and stop
conditions.

## Fault, revision, and conclusion

Connect the conclusion to evidence. Do not hide an unsuccessful test; explain
what it ruled out and what you would test next.
